hypotheses.title: Cashflow Conversion Efficiency and Earnings Predictability Quality Synergy
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In model16, cashflow_efficiency_rank_derivative captures the rate of change in operational cash generation efficiency per dollar of deployed capital, insulating firms from external credit constraints. When synergized with earnings_certainty_rank_derivative (penalizing accounting accruals and earnings volatility), this composite isolates financially resilient, high-quality compounding equities with structural multi-quarter outperformance across TOP3000.
confounders: Speculative liquidity bubbles where unhedged low-quality junk rallies indiscriminately
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if cashflow efficiency and earnings certainty synergy fails to achieve Sharpe >= 1.25 or Fitness >= 1.00.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutralized synthesis of 5-day decayed cashflow efficiency and earnings certainty, ranked uniformly across TOP3000.

hypotheses.title: Growth Potential Trajectory with Institutional Consensus Revision Momentum
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Accelerations in fundamental growth potential (growth_potential_rank_derivative) generate persistent equity drift when ratified by institutional consensus upgrades (analyst_revision_rank_derivative). Due to analyst anchoring bias, sell-side upgrades occur in multi-month cascades, producing a steady post-revision drift that can be systematically captured with 100% instrument coverage.
confounders: Broad macroeconomic guidance cuts during cyclical downturns that override firm-specific upgrades
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if growth trajectory and revision momentum synergy yields Sharpe < 1.25 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-standardized combination of 5-day decayed growth potential and analyst revision momentum.

hypotheses.title: Implied Volatility Term Structure Contango Slope and Event-Risk Discount
hypotheses.economic_rationale: The slope of the implied volatility term structure ((implied_volatility_mean_90 - implied_volatility_mean_30) / implied_volatility_mean_30) reflects structural institutional risk sentiment. In normal market regimes, the curve sits in steep contango (long-term IV > short-term IV), reflecting calm accumulation and low near-term shock probability. Stocks exhibiting top-tier contango slope within each subindustry suffer minimal event drag and deliver superior risk-adjusted returns.
confounders: Unscheduled market-wide macroeconomic shocks that instantaneously flip term structures into backwardation
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if IV term structure contango slope generates Sharpe < 1.25 or fails sub-universe consistency in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: 5-day decayed implied volatility term structure slope, subindustry-neutralized and uniformly ranked.
